meta.title: Multi-Currency Bidding: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same Enterprise tenant, then verify that Multi-Currency Bidding is refused or absent for the former and available for the latter, including vendor bidding in their own currency and publish-time rate locking.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and as a Buyer in the same Enterprise tenant, then verify that Multi-Currency Bidding is refused or absent for the former and available for the latter, including vendor bidding in their own currency and publish-time rate locking.
